result:
Perfect! All tests now pass. 

**The bug:** In `tally/invoice.py:42`, the discount condition was using `>` (greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to). This meant the bulk discount only applied when units *exceeded* 10, not when they reached exactly 10.

**The fix:** Changed the condition from `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` to `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` on line 42.

This aligns with the test name `test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units`, which correctly expects a 5% discount to apply when an order reaches exactly 10 units.
